interface.title: PyMedPhys – MetersetMap Comparison (Streamlit app launcher)
interface.stage_of_work: Patient-specific QA after treatment planning: checking a delivered or re-exported treatment plan against the planned one
interface.what_it_is_for: Turn a reference and an evaluation radiotherapy plan (DICOM RT Plan or linac .trf log) into MLC/jaw fluence maps (MetersetMaps) and compare them with gamma analysis, giving a pass rate, plots and a saved report.

data.note: 06MV_plan.dcm (patient ID 60x60x60, name 'SIMON, Watertank', plan MC06MV, 10000 MU, 20 control points) was uploaded as both Reference and Evaluation. An identical pair can only show that the pipeline runs. It cannot show disagreement, and in this run even that was not shown because the calculation never finished. The browser tab closed by itself partway through, which restarted screenshot numbering. screens/001–018 come from the second session. screens/019–049 come from the first session. First-session files 001–018 (the launcher, the filter box, the first status check) were overwritten and are not cited. The replay's screenshots are under check/screens/.

features.name: Side-by-side reference/evaluation input panels with a source-type selector
features.general: Two matching panels, one per item being compared. Each lets you pick the kind of input, then how to get it (upload or search a configured location), then upload it, and shows the file's identifying metadata and a summary table. A sidebar mirrors both summaries so you can confirm the right pair is loaded.
features.specific: Reference and Evaluation columns, each with: Data Input Method dropdown (DICOM RTPlan file upload / Linac Backup .trf filepath), DICOM or TRF import method radio (File upload / Search Monaco file export location / Search indexed TRF directory), uploader, Patient ID / Name / Plan Name, an 'Overview of selected deliveries' table (MU, number of data points) and Total MU. The sidebar 'MetersetMap Overview' repeats Patient ID / Name / Total MU for each side.
steps: Choose a Data Input Method for each side (needs Advanced Mode)
Choose an import method; a search source with no configuration shows a ConfigMissing message pointing back to File upload
Check the patient, plan and delivery table under the panel
Confirm both sides in the sidebar overview before running
serves_tasks: Set both inputs to take an uploaded plan file
Fetch the item from a configured export location instead of uploading it
Upload the reference item and check what it contains
Upload the item to compare against it

features.name: Gamma-criteria panel shown by an advanced-mode toggle
features.general: An 'advanced' checkbox reveals the agreement-test settings: a percent tolerance, a distance tolerance, a choice of local or global normalisation, and a cap on the index value. These feed the next comparison run.
features.specific: Ticking 'Run in Advanced Mode' shows Gamma parameters: MU Percent Threshold (default 2), Distance (mm) Threshold (default 0.50, step 0.01), Local Gamma checkbox (default on) and Max Gamma (default 5). It also shows Advanced Debugging 'Compare Baseline to Output Directory'. The calculation status does not echo which settings a run used.
steps: Set the distance threshold with the +/- buttons or by typing
Switch between local and global gamma
Set the maximum gamma, then run the calculation
serves_tasks: Set both inputs to take an uploaded plan file
Set the acceptance criteria for the agreement test

features.name: Output destination picker with resolved-path preview
features.general: Before running, pick a named site for the formal report and give a folder for an image record. Once both inputs are loaded, the tool shows the absolute path each choice resolves to, so you can check where the files will land.
features.specific: Output Locations: an 'eScan Site' radio (a-demo-site-name). After both plans are loaded, its resolved PDF directory appears under it, along with a 'png output directory' text box (~/pymedphys-gui-metersetmap) and that box's resolved path. On a fresh page only the eScan radio is shown. The '~' is not expanded: the png path resolves to the literal /work/app/~/pymedphys-gui-metersetmap.

Pick the eScan site for the PDF report

Read the resolved absolute paths before running (watch for an unexpanded '~')
